# freshdesk_forum_categories (Data Source)

Every community forum category on the helpdesk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_forum_categories" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `forum_categories` (Attributes List) Every forum category the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forum_categories))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `forum_categories`.

<a id="nestedatt--forum_categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forum_categories`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the category was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the category.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the forum category.
- `name` (String) Name of the category.
- `updated_at` (String) When the category was last changed (RFC 3339).
